sources.title: GPT X2 125M CIx Long Context — Hardware Requirements & Compatibility
sources.snippet: GPT X2 125M CIx Long Context — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat GPT X2 125M CIx Long Context is a 126M-parameter open language model from reaperdoesntknow. It supports a context window of up to 32,768 tokens. At BF16 it needs about 0.60 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.

sources.title: Models — Axiomic Labs
sources.snippet: The GPT-X family from Axiomic Labs: compact language models trained from scratch for efficient reasoning. Includes GPT-X 125M, GPT-X2 125M, GPT-X2.5 (training), and GPT-X3 (in design).
